newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up 15 cents on firmer LME.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up 15 cents on firmer LME.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed up 15 cents at 14.80 ringgit ($5.85) a kg as a sharp rebound on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight encouraged strong buying here, traders said.
"LME was up $60 last night and this helped the local market to rebound from recent falls," said one trader. "Buying was particularly strong from European interests."

Traders noted initial bids of 259 tonnes against offers of 94 tonnes. Final turnover was 129 tonnes, up from 64 on Wednesday.The local price premium over LME narrowed to $20 a tonne from $55 previously. ($1=2.5280 ringgit)
